description: Lignes BHNS et tramways du SDIT - MEL - 2022 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mel-geoserver.lillemetropole.fr. Data on tram lines and BHNS (High Level Buses) resulting from the consultation report of the SDIT (Schéma Directeur d'Infrastructures de Transport) and voted during the Metropolitan Council of 16 December 2022. Other related data: SDIT tram stations and BHNS - MEL - 2022. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "SDIT BHNS lines and trams - MEL - 2022" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sdit, tramway, transport, métropole européenne de lille, mobilités, bhns. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS. The listing shows 2024-02-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
